agreements: Gearbox v1 verified baseline and Step009 Heartbeat verified foundation remain preserved; this review changes no formal state and claims no C PASS.
v2 strict-validates inherited routing booleans and v2.1 strict-validates secretary_signal_fresh, authority_conflict and direct verification booleans.
v2 real_experience_claim_allowed now requires verified-kind credit plus C_VERIFIED stage; stage hardening is useful but still does not provide trusted verifier provenance.
v2.1 keeps DURABLE_PROGRESS and ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND operational-only, while HEARTBEAT/POLL/RETRY/WAIT/SCHEDULER_WAKE remain zero Experience.
verified_progress_density is reason-only in current bytes and cannot itself raise gear or create Experience; keep it observational.
N/R terminal states bypass anti-thrash gear-number parsing after inherited selection, and malformed non-Mapping ledger elements are bounded ignores.
The v2.1 contract correctly marks speedup NOT_YET_STATISTICALLY_ESTABLISHED.

disagreements.finding: New current-byte material gap: select_gear_v2_1 parses recent_shift_rate_ratio and verified_progress_density before calling inherited v2 and before learning that rollback_required=True or standby=True should produce terminal R/N. Therefore malformed or out-of-range nonessential anti-thrash/progress telemetry can raise GearboxGuardError and prevent a canonical rollback/standby decision from being reached. The later N/R bypass does not protect this earlier parse point.
disagreements.required_change: Safety/terminal authority must not be blockable by nonessential telemetry parsing. Either resolve trusted rollback/standby terminal state before anti-thrash/progress telemetry, or require a trusted prevalidated telemetry envelope whose parse failure deterministically fails to the safer terminal authority result. Add explicit rollback/standby-with-malformed-telemetry tests.

disagreements.finding: EventKind normalization remains inconsistent: experience_candidate_delta uses strip().upper(), select_gear_v2 verified_event uses the original unstripped event_kind.upper(), and v2.1 direct classification uses str(...).upper() without strip. One logical event can receive contradictory credit/classification across paths.
disagreements.required_change: Use one versioned canonical typed EventKind parser exactly once across v2/v2.1 credit, ledger and classification paths.

disagreements.finding: secretary_signal_fresh and authority_conflict remain caller declarations. Strict bool proves type only, not source, timestamp/TTL, revocation, scope, policy or runtime/installation binding.
disagreements.required_change: Require trusted SecretarySignalEnvelope and AuthorityDecisionEnvelope with replay-resistant provenance/freshness binding.

disagreements.finding: authority_conflict only neutralizes secretary_level; it does not load or enforce the exact fresh authority decision, so permissive fallback kwargs still control routing.
disagreements.required_change: Project the exact trusted fresh authority snapshot or fail closed.

disagreements.finding: Secretary freshness protects secretary_level only; numeric pressure fields have no per-field provenance/freshness and can carry stale secretary-derived telemetry into routing.
disagreements.required_change: Bind provenance/freshness per pressure component; stale secretary-derived components contribute zero while independently trusted telemetry may contribute.

disagreements.finding: recent_shift_rate_ratio is caller supplied and thresholded at >=0.50 without canonical numerator/denominator, minimum sample, observation window, uncertainty or stateful enter/exit hysteresis.
disagreements.required_change: Derive from canonical append-only shift history with preregistered support/window/uncertainty and bounded hysteretic release.

disagreements.finding: Anti-thrash can reduce gear_shift_rate while delaying a safe necessary upshift and worsening cycle_completion_latency, verified_closure_per_hour or recovery_latency.
disagreements.required_change: Require paired performance non-regression; fewer shifts alone is not improvement.

disagreements.finding: Verified Experience still depends on event kind, booleans and stage labels; exact evidence hash plus trusted C/independent-verifier identity/receipt are not mandatory.
disagreements.required_change: Require immutable evidence identity and trusted verifier acceptance receipt bound to mission/step/scope, freshness/revocation and installation/workspace identity.

disagreements.finding: event_id dedupe exists only inside one aggregate call. Same evidence under new IDs, cross-run/restart/rollback/poll replay and same-ID rebinding can still be re-credited.
disagreements.required_change: Use a durable rollback-resistant event/evidence-lineage acceptance registry with exact replay NO_OP and rebinding IDENTITY_CONFLICT.

disagreements.finding: aggregate_experience_events still canonicalizes event_id with str(...).strip(), allowing arbitrary caller types, numeric/string aliasing and unstable structured identities.
disagreements.required_change: Define a versioned strict EventIdentity boundary and bind accepted identity to canonical event/evidence/verifier receipt and durable acceptance record.

disagreements.finding: select_gear_v2_1 recomputes verified and operational deltas directly from caller event fields, bypassing aggregate_experience_events and any future durable-ledger repair.
disagreements.required_change: Every nonzero credit must come from one immutable AcceptedExperienceReceipt; receipt-less decision calls emit zero credit.

disagreements.finding: Public v2 still exposes DURABLE_PROGRESS and ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND through experience_candidate_delta although v2.1 classifies them operational-only.
disagreements.required_change: Unify authoritative classification across v2/v2.1; operational progress must never appear in an authoritative Experience-labelled field.

disagreements.finding: 5/4/3 verified credits and operational 1 are engineering heuristics, not calibrated capability units.
disagreements.required_change: Never use aggregate credit as capability truth, Trust, Identity, Personality or promotion threshold.

disagreements.finding: No exact-current paired evaluation establishes speedup; commit count, wake count and awake time are invalid proxies.
disagreements.required_change: Use sealed matched workloads and paired/crossover baselines over durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, rework_ratio and recovery_latency with frozen metric provenance, exposure/censoring/order, complete assigned-workload coverage, uncertainty and verification/risk non-regression.

statistical_risks: Malformed or out-of-range nonessential telemetry can censor rollback/standby observations before the terminal safety decision is produced, biasing safety-path reliability measurements.
Caller-declared secretary freshness/authority and unbound pressure provenance invalidate causal routing comparisons.
Small-n caller-supplied shift-rate estimates can false-trigger anti-thrash or chatter around the threshold.
Anti-thrash may improve gear_shift_rate while degrading cycle/closure/recovery latency.
verified_progress_density becomes self-reinforcing if later connected to routing authority; it must remain observational until independently derived and tested.
Transient event IDs, same-evidence/new-ID replay, noncanonical identity and direct credit bypass can inflate or censor longitudinal Experience/progress totals.
Operational-vs-Experience semantics differ between v2 and v2.1, making mixed-consumer metrics incomparable.
5/4/3/1 credits are ordinal engineering heuristics, not capability units.
Speed metrics are numerator/denominator/exposure/order/coverage sensitive and require matched paired/crossover evaluation.
proposed_tests: GB21-TERMINAL-TELEMETRY-PARSE-103: rollback_required=True with malformed recent_shift_rate_ratio and/or verified_progress_density must still deterministically reach trusted rollback R or an explicitly safer fail-closed terminal result; nonessential telemetry must not block rollback.
GB21-STANDBY-TELEMETRY-PARSE-104: standby=True with malformed/out-of-range anti-thrash/progress telemetry must not crash before N/terminal policy is applied.
GB21-EVENT-KIND-WHITESPACE-101 + EVENT-KIND-CROSSPATH-102: all v2/v2.1 paths consume one canonical EventKind value.
GB21-STALE-PRESSURE-PROVENANCE-059 + MIXED-SOURCE-060: stale secretary-derived pressure fields are ignored while trusted independent telemetry remains usable.
GB21-AUTHORITY-DECISION-PROJECTION-028: trusted fresh authority=G1/recovery projects G1 despite permissive fallback kwargs.
GB21-SHIFT-RATE-PROVENANCE-017 + SHIFT-SMALL-N-004 + ANTI-THRASH-CHATTER-040 + RELEASE-041: canonical shift history, adequate support, uncertainty and bounded release are required.
GB21-PROGRESS-DENSITY-FORGE-007: verified_progress_density=1 alone has zero routing/Experience/promotion/authority effect.
GB21-EVENT-ID-TYPE-098 + EVENT-ID-ALIAS-099 + EVENT-ID-STRUCTURAL-100: adoptable event identity rejects arbitrary types and uses deterministic canonical identity semantics.
GB21-CROSS-RUN-SAME-ID-018 + ROLLBACK-LEDGER-019 + POLL-REPLAY-020 + EVENT-REBIND-021: durable exactly-once and identity-conflict semantics survive restart, rollback and polling.
GB21-VERIFIER-EVIDENCE-011: verified kind without exact evidence hash plus trusted verifier/C receipt gets zero credit.
GB21-DIRECT-CREDIT-BYPASS-022 + OPERATIONAL-CREDIT-BYPASS-024: every nonzero credit is tied to one immutable accepted receipt.
GB21-CREDIT-SCORE-014: equal aggregate scores from different event mixes cannot imply equivalent capability or trigger promotion.

GB21-PAIRED-SPEED-015 + WAKE-DENOMINATOR-FREEZE-030 + TIME-WINDOW-FREEZE-032 + ORDER-CROSSOVER-036 + ITT-WORKLOAD-COVERAGE-038: speedup requires matched workload, frozen metric provenance, crossover/order control, full assigned-workload coverage and uncertainty/non-regression.

requirements: Resolve terminal/safety path precedence so rollback/standby cannot be blocked by nonessential telemetry parse failure.
Use one canonical typed/versioned EventKind parser and one strict versioned EventIdentity boundary across all authoritative paths.
Replace caller freshness/conflict with trusted SecretarySignalEnvelope and AuthorityDecisionEnvelope; fresh authority decision must be projected, not merely secretary-neutralized.
Bind every pressure component to source/freshness and derive recent_shift_rate from canonical history with minimum support, uncertainty and hysteretic release.
Require paired non-regression showing anti-thrash does not worsen cycle_completion_latency, verified_closure_per_hour or recovery_latency.
Keep verified_progress_density observational until independently derived and adversarially shown non-self-reinforcing.
Replace transient event_id dedupe with durable rollback-resistant event/evidence-lineage acceptance registry.
Require exact evidence hash plus trusted C/independent-verifier receipt for verified Experience and route all verified/operational credit through immutable AcceptedExperienceReceipt.
Keep DURABLE_PROGRESS/ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND operational-only and heartbeat/poll/retry/reconnect/window age/uptime at zero Experience.
Treat 5/4/3/1 credit weights as TEST_REQUIRED heuristics only; no capability/Trust/Identity/Personality promotion from aggregate score.

Establish speed only with sealed matched paired/crossover evidence over durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, rework_ratio and recovery_latency, with frozen metric provenance, exposure/censoring/order, assigned-workload coverage, uncertainty and verification/risk non-regression.
Obtain exact-current same-runner executable regression evidence plus fresh Spirit review and Navigator synthesis before any A->B->C adoption route.
